name: exp027b_paired_padded_K2N24_stage1
notes: EXP-027b stage 1 (draws 1-2 of the registered K3 x N24 configuration; 48 cases per mesh). Stage 2 = the K3 config in a NEW work dir seeded with this stage's WORK/cases (the config hash differs), so no case is simulated twice.
